cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country that is not contradicted by a later one. The Herald's June 2026 account of all provincial, 63 district and 206 sub-offices computerised (ZWE-010) is older than the July, August and September 2026 accounts of sub-offices still being computerised.
cells.note: All provinces and districts are computerised, but the newest facts (July to September 2026) describe sub-office computerisation still under way, so stage 2. Question 2 needs its own evidence, so the death fact does not lift it.
